text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ

translations.asad: THE LAST HOUR draws near, and the moon is split asunder!
translations.sahih: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].

text.arabic: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةًۭ يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌۭ مُّسْتَمِرٌّۭ

translations.asad: But if they [who reject all thought of the Last Hour] were to see a sign [of its approach], they would turn aside and say, “An ever-recurring delusion!” –
translations.sahih: And if they see a miracle, they turn away and say, "Passing magic."

text.arabic: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍۢ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ

translations.asad: for they are bent on giving it the lie, being always wont to follow their own desires. Yet everything reveals its truth in the end.
translations.sahih: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.

text.arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ

translations.asad: And withal, there has come unto them many a tiding that should have restrained [their arrogance]:
translations.sahih: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence -

text.arabic: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَٰلِغَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ

translations.asad: far-reaching wisdom [was held out to them]: but [since] all warnings have been of no avail,
translations.sahih: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].

text.arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ نُّكُرٍ

translations.asad: turn thou away from them. On the Day when the Summoning Voice will sum­mon [man] unto something that the mind cannot conceive,
translations.sahih: So leave them, [O Muhammad]. The Day the Caller calls to something forbidding,

text.arabic: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌۭ مُّنتَشِرٌۭ

translations.asad: they will come forth from their graves, with their eyes downcast, [swarming about] like locusts scattered [by the wind],
translations.sahih: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading,

text.arabic: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌۭ

translations.asad: running in con­fusion towards the Summoning Voice; [and] those who [now] deny the truth will exclaim, “Calamitous is this Day!”
translations.sahih: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."

text.arabic: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌۭ وَٱزْدُجِرَ

translations.asad: [LONG] BEFORE those [who now deny resurrec­tion] did Noah’s people call it a lie; and they gave the lie to Our servant and said, “Mad is he!” - and he was repulsed.
translations.sahih: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled.

text.arabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌۭ فَٱنتَصِرْ

translations.asad: Thereupon he called out to his Sustainer, “Verily, I am defeated; come Thou, then, to my succour!”
translations.sahih: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."

text.arabic: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍۢ مُّنْهَمِرٍۢ

translations.asad: And so We caused the gates of heaven to open with water pouring down in torrents,
translations.sahih: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down

text.arabic: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًۭا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍۢ قَدْ قُدِرَ

translations.asad: and caused the earth to burst forth with springs, so that the waters met for a purpose pre-ordained:
translations.sahih: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.

text.arabic: وَحَمَلْنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍۢ وَدُسُرٍۢ

translations.asad: but him We bore on that [vessel] made of [mere] planks and nails,
translations.sahih: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,

text.arabic: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءًۭ لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ

translations.asad: and it floated under Our eyes: a recom­pense for him who had been rejected with ingratitude.
translations.sahih: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied.

text.arabic: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَٰهَآ ءَايَةًۭ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ

translations.asad: And, indeed, We have caused such [floating vessels] to remain forever a sign [of Our grace unto man]: who, then, is willing to take it to heart?
translations.sahih: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?

text.arabic: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

translations.asad: And how severe is the suffering which I inflict when My warnings are disregarded!
translations.sahih: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

text.arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ

translations.asad: Hence, indeed, We made this Qur’an easy to bear in mind: who, then, is willing to take it to heart?
translations.sahih: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

text.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌۭ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

translations.asad: TO THE TRUTH gave the lie [the tribe of] Ad: and how severe was the suffering which I inflicted when My warnings were disregarded!
translations.sahih: 'Aad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

text.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًۭا صَرْصَرًۭا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍۢ مُّسْتَمِرٍّۢ

translations.asad: Behold, We let loose upon them a raging storm wind on a day of bitter misfortune:
translations.sahih: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,

text.arabic: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍۢ مُّنقَعِرٍۢ

translations.asad: it swept the people away as though they were palm-trunks uprooted:
translations.sahih: Extracting the people as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.

text.arabic: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

translations.asad: for, how severe is the suffering which I inflict when My warnings are disregarded!
translations.sahih: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

text.arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ

translations.asad: Hence, indeed, We made this Qur’an easy to bear in mind: who, then, is willing to take it to heart?
translations.sahih: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

text.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ

translations.asad: [AND the tribe of] Thamud gave the lie to all [Our] warnings;
translations.sahih: Thamud denied the warning

text.arabic: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًۭا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًۭا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًۭا لَّفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍ

translations.asad: and they said: “Are we to follow one single mortal, one from among ourselves? In that case, behold, we would certainly sink into error and folly!
translations.sahih: And said, "Is it one human being among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.

text.arabic: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌۭ

translations.asad: Why - on him alone from among all of us should a [divine] reminder have been bestowed? Nay, but he is a boastful liar!”
translations.sahih: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar."

text.arabic: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًۭا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ

translations.asad: [And God said:] “On the morrow they will come to know who the boastful liar is!
translations.sahih: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.

text.arabic: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةًۭ لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ

translations.asad: Behold, [O Salih] We are letting loose this she-camel as a test for them; and thou but watch them, and contain thyself in patience.
translations.sahih: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.

text.arabic: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍۢ مُّحْتَضَرٌۭ

translations.asad: And let them know that the water [of their wells] is to be divided between them, with each share of water equitably apportioned.”
translations.sahih: And inform them that the water is shared between them, each [day of] drink attended [by turn].

text.arabic: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ

translations.asad: But they summoned their [boldest] companion, and he ventured [upon the evil deed], and cruelly slaughtered [the animal]:
translations.sahih: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her].

text.arabic: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

translations.asad: and how severe was the suffering which I inflicted when My warnings were disregarded!
translations.sahih: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

text.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ

translations.asad: Behold, We let loose upon them one single blast [of Our punishment], and they became like the dried-up, crumbling twigs of a sheepfold.
translations.sahih: Indeed, We sent upon them one blast from the sky, and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.

text.arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ

translations.asad: Hence, indeed, We made this Qur’an easy to bear in mind: who, then, is willing to take it to heart?
translations.sahih: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

text.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ

translations.asad: LOT ’S PEOPLE [too] gave the lie to all [Our] warn­ings:
translations.sahih: The people of Lot denied the warning.

text.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَٰهُم بِسَحَرٍۢ

translations.asad: [and so,] behold, We let loose upon them a deadly tempest; and only Lot ’s kinsfolk did We save at the break of dawn,
translations.sahih: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn

text.arabic: نِّعْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ

translations.asad: as a blessing from Us: thus do We reward all who are grateful.
translations.sahih: As favor from us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.

text.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ

translations.asad: For he had truly warned them of Our punishing might; but they stubbornly cast doubt on these warn­ings,
translations.sahih: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning.

text.arabic: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

translations.asad: and even demanded that he give up his guests [to them]: whereupon We deprived them of their sight [and thus told them, as it were]: “Taste, then, the suffering which I inflict when My warnings are disregarded!”
translations.sahih: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."

text.arabic: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌۭ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ

translations.asad: And, indeed, abiding suffering did befall them early on the morrow:
translations.sahih: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.

text.arabic: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

translations.asad: “Taste, then, the suffering which I inflict when My warnings are disregarded!”
translations.sahih: So taste My punishment and warning.

text.arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ

translations.asad: Hence, indeed, We made this Qur’an easy to bear in mind: who, then, is willing to take it to heart?
translations.sahih: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

text.arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ

translations.asad: Now surely, unto Pharaoh’s folk [too] came such warnings;
translations.sahih: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.

text.arabic: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍ

translations.asad: they, too, gave the lie to all Our messages: and thereupon We took them to task as only the Almighty, who determines all things, can take to task.
translations.sahih: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.

text.arabic: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌۭ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ

translations.asad: ARE, THEN, those of you who [now] deny the truth better than those others - or have you, per­chance, [been promised] immunity in the [ancient] books of [divine] wisdom?
translations.sahih: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scripture?

text.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌۭ مُّنتَصِرٌۭ

translations.asad: Or do they say, “We are a group united, [and therefore] bound to prevail”?
translations.sahih: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]"?

text.arabic: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ

translations.asad: [Yet] the hosts [of those who deny the truth] shall be routed, and they shall turn their backs [in flight]!
translations.sahih: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].

text.arabic: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ

translations.asad: But nay - the Last Hour is the time when they shall truly meet their fate; and that Last Hour will be most calamitous, and most bitter:
translations.sahih: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.

text.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍۢ

translations.asad: for, behold, those who are lost in sin [will at that time come to know that it is they who] were sunk in error and folly!
translations.sahih: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness.

text.arabic: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ

translations.asad: On the Day when they shall be dragged into the fire on their faces, [they will be told:] “Taste now the touch of hell-fire!”
translations.sahih: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar."

text.arabic: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَٰهُ بِقَدَرٍۢ

translations.asad: BEHOLD, everything have We created in due measure and proportion;
translations.sahih: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.

text.arabic: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌۭ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ

translations.asad: and Our ordaining [a thing and its coming into being] is but one [act], like the twinkling of an eye.
translations.sahih: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.

text.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ

translations.asad: Thus, indeed, did We destroy people like you [in the past]: who, then, is willing to take it to heart?
translations.sahih: And We have already destroyed your kinds, so is there any who will remember?

text.arabic: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍۢ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ

translations.asad: [They were truly guilty] because all [the evil] that they ever did had been [revealed to them as such] in the [ancient] books of [divine] wisdom;
translations.sahih: And everything they did is in written records.

text.arabic: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍۢ وَكَبِيرٍۢ مُّسْتَطَرٌ

translations.asad: and everything [that man does], be it small or great, is recorded [with God].
translations.sahih: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.

text.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَنَهَرٍۢ

translations.asad: [Hence, too,] behold, the God-conscious will find themselves in [a paradise of] gardens and running waters,
translations.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,

text.arabic: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ

translations.asad: in a seat of truth, in the presence of a Sovereign who determines all things.
translations.sahih: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.
